title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE, relative to expanding low- income financial assistance programs for the City's utility services.
text:
[Council File 26-1576; CD 2]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE, relative to expanding low- income financial assistance programs for the City's utility services.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Nazarian - Price):
REQUEST the Department of Water and Power, in coordination with the City Attorney and Office of Finance, to provide a report in 60 days analyzing the feasibility of expanding the low-income financial assistance programs in regard to the City's utility services bill. The feasibility report should recommend ways to increase the capacity of the number of participating households and/or identify ways to increase available funding to provide greater assistance to low-income families, in coordination with the Office of Finance in consideration of its role as the administrator of the Lifeline Rate Application Program.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Asks to expand low-income financial assistance programs for the city's utility services.
